intro.title: About Me
intro.desc1: I’m Virat Sathavara, a ReactJS Developer with hands-on experience in building dynamic and performance-driven web applications. I completed my Bachelor's in Computer Engineering in June 2024 from Smt. S. R. Patel Engineering College with a CGPA of 8.38.
intro.desc2: As a Frontend Developer at Coddit64, I work on the US-based healthcare platform SHIFTit, managing the Hospital Web Portal with Next.js, Typescript, Tailwind CSS, and API integrations. I handle modules like shift management, messaging, dashboards, listings, invoices, and contribute to the Admin Panel for managing hospitals, workers, and compliance. I focus on delivering responsive, high-performance interfaces and seamless backend integration using modern frontend technologies.
